title: 第一卷 正文第23章 任务完成第一卷 正文第24章 风魂阵
content_zh:
话音落下，楚凌天右手双指并拢，朝着身前一挥。
“玄火剑指！”
他的指尖，瞬间凝聚出一道数米长的赤色剑气。
其散发出的威势，比金色刀气更强，直接冲散了它的刀意！
“这怎么可能！”
王猛双眼暴睁，露出不敢置信之色。
在他惊恐的目光中，赤色剑气与金色刀气狠狠相撞。
“锵！”
一道刺耳的金铁交击声响起。
金色刀气虽然威力不俗，但楚凌天的修为已经达到了灵师三重天初期，更是将《玄火剑指》修炼到了中成之境。其威力，根本不是金色刀气能够抗衡的。
不到一息，金色刀气便被斩碎，化为虚无。
随后，赤色剑气威力不减，径直劈在王猛的身上，将他劈飞。
“你的修为不是灵师二重天，而是灵师三重天！”王猛捂着鲜血淋漓的伤口，艰难地爬起身。
刚才那一击，已经将他重创。此时他就算想跑，也跑不了了。
王猛回过头，恶狠狠地瞪了一眼苏媚，骂道：“贱人，你竟敢诓骗老子！”
如果他知道楚凌天的修为是灵师三重天，绝不会来招惹楚凌天。
苏媚脸色惨白，双腿一软，瘫坐在地上，喃喃道：“怎么会这样，半个月前，他的修为明明只有灵师一重天中期。”
苏媚做梦也不会想到，他们的半个月，对于拥有混沌宝塔的楚凌天来说，乃是四年多！
王猛看着一步步走来楚凌天，连忙开口道：“楚兄，这一切都是误会。只要楚兄放我一马，这柄斩金刀就归楚兄所有。”
说着，他双手捧起斩金刀，态度十分诚恳。

但楚凌天嘴角却勾起一抹冷笑：“杀了你，这柄斩金刀不还是我的？”
虽然王猛低头求饶、态度诚恳，但楚凌天作为一品高阶炼丹师，灵魂力量强大，他清楚地感应到，王猛眼中的怨恨。
很显然，只要楚凌天放了王猛，回去后王猛必定会疯狂报复。
正所谓斩草不除根，春风吹又生。
楚凌天自然不会给自己留下祸患。
王猛感受到楚凌天眼中的杀意，浑身一颤，大声威胁道：“楚凌天，本少乃是北江郡豪族王家的嫡系子弟，我父亲乃是王家的长老。你若是杀了我，我父亲绝对不会放过你的！”
对于王猛的威胁，楚凌天根本没有放在心上。
“废话说完了，你也该上路了，你的狗腿子还在黄泉路上等着你呢！”
说罢，楚凌天没有再给王猛开口的机会，一掌拍在他的头顶，直接了结他。
苏媚看着双眼大睁、死不瞑目的王猛，吓得尖叫连连。
content_en:
After the words fell, Chu Lingtian put the fingers of his right hand together and waved in front of him.
"Xuanhuo Sword Finger!"
His fingertips instantly condensed a red sword energy several meters long.
The power it exudes is stronger than the golden sword energy, and it directly disperses its sword intent!
"How is this possible!"
Wang Meng's eyes widened with disbelief.
In his horrified eyes, the red sword energy and the golden sword energy collided fiercely.
"Qiang!"
A harsh sound of gold and iron clashing sounded.
Although the golden sword energy is quite powerful, Chu Lingtian's cultivation level has reached the early stage of the third level of spiritual master, and he has even cultivated the "Mysterious Fire Sword Finger" to the state of intermediate perfection. Its power is simply not something that the golden sword energy can compete with.
In less than a breath, the golden sword energy was chopped into pieces and turned into nothingness.
Then, the power of the red sword energy remained unabated and struck Wang Meng directly, sending him flying.
"Your cultivation is not the second level of spiritual master, but the third level of spiritual master!" Wang Meng covered his bloody wound and climbed up with difficulty.
The blow just now had severely injured him. Even if he wanted to run at this time, he couldn't.
Wang Meng turned around, glared at Su Mei fiercely, and cursed: "Bitch, how dare you lie to me!"
If he knew that Chu Lingtian's cultivation was at the third level of spiritual master, he would never provoke Chu Lingtian.
Su Mei's face turned pale, her legs went weak, and she collapsed on the ground, muttering: "How could this happen? Half a month ago, his cultivation level was only in the middle stage of the first level of the spiritual master."
Su Mei never dreamed that their half month would be more than four years for Chu Lingtian who owned the Chaos Pagoda!
Wang Meng looked at Chu Lingtian approaching step by step, and said quickly: "Brother Chu, this is all a misunderstanding. As long as Brother Chu lets me go, this golden sword will belong to Brother Chu."
As he said that, he held the gold-killing knife in both hands with a very sincere attitude.
But a sneer appeared at the corner of Chu Lingtian's lips: "If I kill you, won't this golden sword still belong to me?"
Although Wang Meng bowed his head and begged for mercy with a sincere attitude, Chu Lingtian, as a first-grade high-level alchemist with strong soul power, could clearly sense the resentment in Wang Meng's eyes.
Obviously, as long as Chu Lingtian lets Wang Meng go, Wang Meng will definitely take revenge wildly after returning.
As the saying goes, if you cut the grass without removing the root, it will grow again when the spring breeze blows.
Chu Lingtian would naturally not leave any trouble for himself.
Wang Meng felt the killing intent in Chu Lingtian's eyes, trembled all over, and threatened loudly: "Chu Lingtian, I am a direct descendant of the wealthy Wang family in Beijiang County, and my father is the elder of the Wang family. If you kill me, my father will never let you go!"
Chu Lingtian didn't take Wang Meng's threat to heart at all.
"Enough talking nonsense, it's time for you to hit the road. Your bastard is still waiting for you on the road to hell!"
After saying that, Chu Lingtian didn't give Wang Meng another chance to speak. He slapped him on the head and killed him directly.
Su Mei looked at Wang Meng, whose eyes were wide open and staring at death, and she screamed in fright.
